answer: Tiered Reputation Terrace: new identities start on the lowest terrace, where every transaction carries a withholding levy paid to counterparties. Each clone must transact repeatedly before reaching the orchard of trusted tiers, and the accumulated levies exceed any gain from a single sybil action. The umber ledger records each withheld amount. An attacker cloning N identities pays N times the levy chain, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
